query:
SELECT 
  ca.id, ca.auditId, ca.competitorUrl, ca.status, ca.overallScore,
  ca.createdAt, ca.completedAt,
  LENGTH(ca.findings) as findings_len
FROM competitor_audits ca
WHERE ca.auditId = 3450003
ORDER BY ca.createdAt DESC;
